extracted.name: Healthy Turkey Loaf
extracted.description: Lean ground turkey in a flavorful mixture of salsa, bell pepper, egg and onion. The ease of meatloaf without the calories! Easily frozen and baked later for a quick meal.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

In a large bowl combine the turkey, egg, salsa, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, onion, bread crumbs and lemon pepper. Mix well with hands until blended. Roll into a small loaf and place on a foil-lined baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
